title: Test files leak temp blob directories (no TempDir guard)
description: harness.rs:57-65, group_and_receipt.rs:94-102, static_files_test.rs:82-90: make_blob_store() creates subdirectories under std::env::temp_dir() with no tempfile::TempDir guard. Directories persist after test process exits, accumulating on CI runners. The e2e.rs version correctly returns a TempDir guard alongside the store. Fix all three to use tempfile::TempDir and return the guard so it lives as long as the store.
